title: Trash
intro_one: What you delete waits here for {{count}} day, with everything it held. Restore it whenever you like; after that, it’s deleted for good.
intro_other: What you delete waits here for {{count}} days, with everything it held. Restore it whenever you like; after that, it’s deleted for good.
